remarks: Welcome to 152 Long Lots ~ Perfectly sited on two flat acres in the highly sought after Hoyt Farm neighborhood. This home is a rare blend of timeless design and thoughtful scale. The interior is filled with natural light and symmetry which guides you through elegant, functional spaces designed for both everyday living and entertaining. The gourmet kitchen is the heart of the home featuring a wall of windows, top of the line appliances, and the perfect setting for dining in. The primary suite offers a private balcony updated bathroom and shared walk-in closet. The outdoors is equally impressive with a beautiful private patio and mature plantings. Convenient to schools, train, parks and New Canaan town center.
